regime_disposition.decision: retain causal telemetry and route-specific mechanisms; do not use universal regime confidence for leverage

latest_v39_onset_accuracy.interpretation: The apparent TREND_DOWN onset advantage is hypothesis-generating only because twelve clustered observations cannot establish calibration. HYPE's repeated-row 60-minute TREND_UP accuracy was 67.3 percent, while its onset-only accuracy was 42.9 percent on seven observations, demonstrating why repeated rows cannot select leverage.

latest_v49_cross_restart_accuracy.interpretation: The enlarged exact compatible-run window still rejects regime-controlled leverage. At 60 minutes, BTC canonical TREND_DOWN context changed from 31.7% to 45.5% directional accuracy as repeated observations increased from 142 to 178. HYPE context TREND_UP fell from 69.7% to 61.2% over the same expansion, while its primary TREND_DOWN label remained only 20.4% correct across 113; provider-route episode onsets remain one to a handful. The changing repeated-row rates, contradictions, and autocorrelation prevent using them as sizing authority.

regime_disposition.falsifier: Predeclared route-specific regime interactions calibrate consistently to realized after-cost outcomes across independent forward episodes.

exit_and_sizing_disposition.decision: retain the frozen v49 exits and equal 15-percent sizing for the first compatible forward window; compare risk-balanced sizing report-only

The fallback is materially involved in the measured rare-winner mechanism, so shortening it or adding a generic trailing stop is not supported.
exit_and_sizing_disposition.hype_exit_finding: The frozen control exit remained superior to all three tested profit-lock challengers. Development control net was +1044.3616 bps; the challengers were -1850.4565, -1542.7353, and -1525.0217 bps. Retain the 8-hour soft / 24-hour hard control while collecting forward evidence.
exit_and_sizing_disposition.sol_exit_finding: The exact event replay compared native exits with fixed 25, 40, 60, 80, and 120-bps targets. Only 60 bps was positive after removing its largest winner (+$18.540), but only two of four chronological blocks were positive and the result was entirely long-side driven: longs were +$138.215 while shorts were -$99.311. Retain the native bidirectional exit for the first compatible forward window and treat a separately frozen long-60/short-native policy as a report-only challenger rather than a silent live change.
exit_and_sizing_disposition.btc_exit_finding: Hulk retains its structural stop clamped to 20-75 bps, 3R target, and 24-hour fallback. Liquidity Sweep retains its symmetric 60-bps stop and target plus 24-hour fallback; its 64.67-percent modeled friction-adjusted breakeven rate and sparse sample prevent claiming optimization.
exit_and_sizing_disposition.risk_balanced_assessment: Inverse-p99 sizing improves per-asset concentration but reduces the modeled aggregate wave by less than one percent and increases ETH allocation despite partition instability. Exact-notional depth repricing and compatible forward route outcomes are required before changing live sizing.
exit_and_sizing_disposition.confidence: high on frozen arithmetic; low-medium on future exit and sizing optimality
exit_and_sizing_disposition.falsifier: A predeclared, exact-friction exit challenger improves chronological fold stability and largest-winner robustness, or exact-notional repricing and forward outcomes support a materially better sizing map.

The live routing decision arrived 28.445 seconds after the bar close, later than the corrected v3 15-second prospective-decision contract. This is provisional signal-mechanism evidence only; its final venue-costed close and prospective v3 rows remain required.
live_lifecycle_root_cause_disposition.confidence: high on exact current-run attribution; low on causal extrapolation from one fresh SPCX lifecycle
